<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/custodians/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Permanently deletes a Custodian. A Custodian that still has Accounts or
unsettled Payments returns `409 conflict`. To retire an institution while
keeping its history, set `status` to `inactive` instead.
